last_assistant_message:
Done. I've added both privacy usage descriptions to the `project.pbxproj` in both Debug and Release configurations:

- **`INFOPLIST_KEY_NSCameraUsageDescription`** — "SwiftMandarin needs camera access to scan and recognize text from photos for translation."
- **`INFOPLIST_KEY_NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`** — "SwiftMandarin needs photo library access to select images containing text for translation."

Since `GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE = YES`, Xcode will automatically include these in the generated Info.plist at build time. Rebuild and run — the crash should be resolved.
